summary: POS barcode feature: tested backend (15/15 pytest pass) and the frontend on web at 375x667. All backend endpoints work as specified: by-barcode lookup (barcode and SKU), quick-add (400/409), POS invoice stock decrement, WhatsApp link with 05->9665 normalization, EAN-13 '20' generation (idempotent, valid check digit), HTML label with SVG barcode and copies, customer 403. On the frontend, scanner modal, manual entry, existing-barcode add-to-cart, barcode search, product-form generate and print (after save) all work. Problems found: (1) on web the unknown-barcode flow does nothing because react-native-web Alert.alert with buttons is a no-op, so the quick-add modal never opens. The modal itself works; I confirmed it with a temporary window.confirm patch, which I reverted. The post-checkout Alert holding the WhatsApp and Print buttons has the same problem. (2) Products created through the product form have no global `stock` (ProductInput has no stock field), so one POS sale sets stock=0 and in_stock=false. (3) Cashier (pos perm) gets 403 on quick-add, but the UI still offers 'add product'. (4) The Print Label button shows before the product is saved and opens a JSON 400 page. (5) The product-form sticky Save button is covered by the merchant bottom tab bar. No deprecated Expo packages detected (expo-camera ~17 used correctly).

critical.issue: ProductInput (server.py ~1716) has no `stock` field and product-form has no global stock input, so products created through the form have no stock. decrement_stock treats None as 0, so the first POS sale sets stock=0 and in_stock=False and the product shows as out of stock online. Reproduced: create via POST /merchant/products, sell 1, then stock=0 and in_stock=false.

minor.issue: Cashier (perms pos/invoices/orders/customers) gets 403 'يتطلب صلاحية: products' from the employee perm middleware (_PERM_MAP '/api/merchant/products'). Cashiers at the POS can't use the quick-add flow. Either add a ('POST','/api/merchant/products/quick-add') → {'pos'} alt, or hide the add option for users without the products perm.

An employee can get the WhatsApp text (customer phone and items) of any invoice, including invoices they get 403 on for GET /api/pos/invoice/{id}. The own-invoice check from get_invoice is missing (verified: cashier 403 on the invoice, 200 on its /whatsapp).
Barcode uniqueness is not enforced in the regular create/update (duplicate TESTUI001 accepted, 200). by-barcode then returns an arbitrary match. Only quick-add checks for duplicates.
branch_id is accepted but ignored; no branch_inventory row is created for the selected branch.
Prefix match grants pos-perm employees every GET under /api/merchant/products/* (e.g. /{pid}/deep-analytics, /{pid}/label). Pre-existing and over-permissive.

ui_bugs.issue: Alert.alert with buttons is a no-op on react-native-web. On web, scanning or entering an unknown code silently does nothing, and the quick-add modal never opens. Use a cross-platform confirm (window.confirm when Platform.OS==='web'), or open the quick-add modal directly with an 'unregistered barcode' message.

The success Alert holding the 'إرسال واتساب' and 'طباعة' buttons is a no-op on web. The invoice is created and the cart clears, but the user gets no confirmation and can't reach the WhatsApp receipt or print.

The button appears as soon as a barcode is generated or typed on an existing product, before saving. The label endpoint then returns the raw JSON {'detail':'المنتج ليس له باركود'} in a new tab. Show it only when the saved barcode equals the current value, or auto-save / call POST /products/{id}/barcode.
The barcode is generated on the client with no uniqueness check, and the backend POST /merchant/products/{pid}/barcode endpoint is unused. Use the backend endpoint for existing products.

integration_issues.issue: The backend returns 403 for cashiers, but the UI still offers 'إضافة منتج', so the cashier fills the form and then gets an error.

issues: The sticky 'Save Changes' button (y≈620 on 375x667) is covered by the floating merchant bottom tab bar. Tapping it hits the 'Live Store' button and navigates to /merchant/live-preview. Save button has no testID.
The quick-stock input overflows the right edge of the sheet at 375px width (the flex:1 inputs in the row don't shrink; add minWidth:0).
No KeyboardAvoidingView in the quick-add sheet or the scanner manual-entry row (the bottom input will sit under the keyboard on device).
The POS search TextInput and product cards have no testID.
The cart bar (bottom:88) sits right above the floating tab bar and slightly overlaps the center Live Store button.

action_items: HIGH: Make the unknown-barcode confirm and the checkout success (WhatsApp/Print) work on web: use window.confirm on web, or an in-app modal instead of Alert.alert with buttons.

HIGH: Unified inventory: add `stock: Optional[int]` to ProductInput and a stock field to the product form, or make decrement_stock skip the global stock when the field is absent, so a POS sale can't zero out products that have no stock field.
Allow pos-perm employees to call quick-add (and optionally the barcode generator), or hide the 'add product' option for them.
Add the employee own-invoice check to GET /pos/invoice/{id}/whatsapp.
Hide or disable product-barcode-print until the barcode is saved.
Fix the product-form sticky Save button hidden behind the bottom tab bar, and add a testID to it.
Fix the quick-stock overflow and add KeyboardAvoidingView to the scanner and quick-add modals.
critical_code_review_comments: barcodes.py is clean: _id excluded, Pydantic validated, html.escape used in the label, copies clamped to 1-100.
The label/print URL carries the JWT in a query string (token=), so it lands in proxy/browser history. Same pattern as invoice print; consider a short-lived signed token.
BarcodeScannerModal uses autoCapitalize='characters' on manual input, which uppercases alphanumeric SKUs. Lookup is case-sensitive in the backend but case-insensitive in local search.
product-form onChangeText trims on every keystroke, so internal spaces can't be typed (minor).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_pos_barcodes.py (new). pos.tsx was temporarily patched to bypass Alert on web for testing, then restored byte-for-byte from backup.

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 pytest; plus 2 extra issues found in manual checks)
success_rate.frontend: ~70% (scanner open, manual entry, known barcode to cart, barcode search, checkout and stock decrement, generate, print after save all work; unknown-barcode quick-add and checkout WhatsApp are unreachable on web)

seed_data_creation: All TEST* products created were deleted. Invoices INV-000031 and a few test invoices remain, since invoices are immutable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via /login testIDs login-phone-input/login-password-input/login-submit-button. The POS scanner modal slides in, so wait about 2s before clicking scanner-manual-submit. On web there is no camera; scanner-permission box shows. The product-form Save button sits under the tab bar, so use dispatch_event('click') on the 'Save Changes' text. Label opens in a popup (context.expect_page).
rca_of_issue: Web quick-add failure: react-native-web implements Alert.alert as a no-op, so the onPress callbacks never run. Stock zeroing: ProductInput has no stock field, so form-created products have no `stock`, and decrement_stock computes max(0, (None or 0) - qty) = 0 and sets in_stock False.
